question: Your town is facing historic, fast-rising river floods. You are part of a committee charged with relocating priceless ancient manuscripts from the museum’s basement to one of three possible emergency shelters with minimal time to spare. After you vote, the manuscripts will be moved to the chosen shelter immediately. Only the correct location will guarantee their survival.
